subject: NULL object reference
notes: kb/Work PB1137 (landed w61j). Format: the underlined word NULL (cite.py --check 8.4.3.7.2 OK), an identifier (8.4.3.1.3 SR7). It now parses in every INVOKE identifier-5 slot: keyword-less and BY CONTENT (the literal alternative's figurativeConstant) and BY VALUE (invokeArgument's BY VALUE brace gained `literal`, the printed literal-2 that also carries NULL; before it `USING BY VALUE NULL` was COBOL0001). Binding: BY CONTENT / keyword-less NULL into an object-reference formal crosses as the null reference (golden: NULL LO=NULL twice). A BY VALUE NULL reaches the BY VALUE formal refusal that kb/Work PB1051 owns (COBOL0899 / 0828 SR5b) rather than a parse error. The 1985 non-reserved spelling is unchanged (NULL_ is a reservedGatedWord).
